extends CharacterBody2D

@export var speed: float = 240.0
@export_range(1.0, 2000.0, 1.0) var dash_speed: float = 720.0
@export_range(0.01, 2.0, 0.01) var dash_duration: float = 0.16
@export_range(0.0, 10.0, 0.05) var dash_cooldown: float = 0.8

var _facing_direction: Vector2 = Vector2.RIGHT
var _dash_direction: Vector2 = Vector2.RIGHT
var _dash_time_left: float = 0.0
var _cooldown_time_left: float = 0.0

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	_dash_time_left = maxf(0.0, _dash_time_left - delta)
	_cooldown_time_left = maxf(0.0, _cooldown_time_left - delta)
	var direction: Vector2 = Input.get_vector("ui_left", "ui_right", "ui_up", "ui_down")
	if _dash_time_left <= 0.0:
		if not direction.is_zero_approx():
			_facing_direction = direction.normalized()
		if Input.is_action_just_pressed(&"dash") and _cooldown_time_left <= 0.0:
			_dash_direction = _facing_direction
			_dash_time_left = dash_duration
			# Cooldown starts on activation; holding dash never repeats it.
			_cooldown_time_left = dash_cooldown

	velocity = _dash_direction * dash_speed if _dash_time_left > 0.0 else direction * speed
	move_and_slide()
	position = position.clamp(Vector2(16, 16), get_viewport_rect().size - Vector2(16, 16))

extends SceneTree

const PlayerController = preload(\"res://player.gd\")
var _player: PlayerController
var _failures: int = 0

func _initialize() -> void:
	_run.call_deferred()

func _run() -> void:
	var scene: Node = load(\"res://main.tscn\").instantiate()
	root.add_child(scene)
	_player = scene.get_node(\"Player\") as PlayerController
	await _step()

	_key(true)
	await _step()
	_expect(_player.velocity.is_equal_approx(Vector2.RIGHT * _player.dash_speed), \"Shift starts a full-speed dash from idle\")
	_key(false)
	Input.action_press(&\"ui_left\")
	await _step(3)
	_expect(_player.velocity.x > _player.speed, \"Reversing input cannot steer an active dash\")
	await _step(12)
	_expect(_player.velocity.is_equal_approx(Vector2.LEFT * _player.speed), \"Normal movement resumes after the burst\")
	Input.action_release(&\"ui_left\")
	_key(true)
	await _step()
	_expect(_player.velocity.is_zero_approx(), \"A new press during cooldown is rejected\")
	_key(false)
	await _step(60)

	Input.action_press(&\"ui_up\")
	Input.action_press(&\"ui_right\")
	_pad(true)
	await _step()
	_expect(is_equal_approx(_player.velocity.length(), _player.dash_speed) and _player.velocity.x > 0.0 and _player.velocity.y < 0.0, \"Gamepad A starts a normalized diagonal dash after cooldown\")
	Input.action_release(&\"ui_up\")
	Input.action_release(&\"ui_right\")
	await _step(60)
	_expect(_player.velocity.is_zero_approx(), \"Holding dash past cooldown does not repeat it\")
	_pad(false)
	await _step()
	_player.position = Vector2(780, 20)
	_pad(true)
	await _step(12)
	_expect(_player.position.x <= 784.0 and _player.position.y >= 16.0, \"Dash preserves viewport bounds\")
	_pad(false)

	print(\"Dash regression: %s\" % (\"passed\" if _failures == 0 else \"FAILED (%d)\" % _failures))
	quit(0 if _failures == 0 else 1)

func _step(frames: int = 1) -> void:
	for frame in range(frames):
		await physics_frame
		await process_frame

func _key(pressed: bool) -> void:
	var event := InputEventKey.new()
	event.physical_keycode = KEY_SHIFT
	event.pressed = pressed
	Input.parse_input_event(event)

func _pad(pressed: bool) -> void:
	var event := InputEventJoypadButton.new()
	event.device = 0
	event.button_index = JOY_BUTTON_A
	event.pressed = pressed
	Input.parse_input_event(event)

func _expect(condition: bool, description: String) -> void:
	if condition:
		print(\"PASS: \", description)
	else:
		_failures += 1
		push_error(description)
